svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.triangular-pyramid-orthographic-views", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "One triangular-base pyramid: base in z=0 and apex(0,0,5). Top above front, right view beside front, all at10mm/unit. Top shows all apex edges meeting at its projected interior point; front/right use visible silhouette with occluded coincident/internal rear edges omitted. External top/front/right key essential; not independent arbitrary triangles, a regular tetrahedron or exact APH worksheet.", "geometry_exception": "Native1.2mm graphic dots with3.1mm guard; logical junctions de-duplicated, optional near-corner points omitted. Continuous Swell/ViewPlus paths shared; cone axial plane traces have explicit width and ViewPlus role differences.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: Native1.2mm graphic dots with3.1mm guard, logical junctions de-duplicated. Cone endpoints lie at analytic axial intersections; pyramid top apex is a true shared junction. Curves and boundaries are coarse sampled alternatives, not validated touch.
